result.brief: 提出基于可解释性（注意力/梯度 rollout 与五项忠实度、定位指标）的框架，比较分类监督与字幕生成监督下视觉编码器表征的语义结构差异，为超越下游精度的表征评估提供量化手段。
result.reason: Compares visual encoder representations under caption vs classification supervision, offering an explainability-based framework for assessing learned visual representation semantics.
